purpose: 四张地图的边缘设计参考，尚未实装
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a professional fantasy action-RPG MAP PERIMETER DESIGN ART BOARD, 3840x2560 landscape if possible. Exactly FOUR equal large panels in a 2x2 grid; each is an entire continuous small outdoor playable courtyard with its themed natural perimeter visible on all four sides. Labels only B01, B02, B03, B04 unobtrusive at each panel top. Shared visual language: gorgeous bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy, warm sun from upper left, fresh vivid colors, fine purple-brown contour lines, high three-quarter overhead near-isometric 2.5D, chunky believable stone/plants/architecture, consistent camera scale; crisp readable main ground with room to fight. B01 upper-left: cream classical ruin terrace with teal waterways ONLY BEYOND the outer edge, brass sun-clock garden, ivy ruins, little magical greenhouse and stone balustrade; north ivy column garden, east flowing aqueduct below terrace, south flower planters and low broken fence, west open arch entry. B02 upper-right: open sunlit insect civilization hive valley, golden honeycomb resin and pale wax paving, giant leaf balconies, translucent amber roots and seed-pod houses around outer edges, dragonfly wing awnings, tiny pollen lanterns; mint foliage, yellow, bright violet. B03 lower-left: cheerful whimsical pumpkin zombie town courtyard, mint stone paving, pastel purple-roof crooked homes north and east, jack-o-lantern flower gardens and carved low graveyard fence south, tiny ghost tea stall and coffin postbox west; no gore, sunlit, pleasant. B04 lower-right: sunlit red sandstone orc/ogre warcamp arena, pale sand-stone central ground, terracotta layered cliffs and indigo banner palisade north, faraway desert beyond east, bone arch entry west, enormous war-drum terrace and cactus/bone flower planters south; whimsical colorful tribal fantasy. Show how each walkable floor organically meets a low curb, plants or low outer wall, then a broad atmospheric background outside the gameplay boundary. No blank gray margins; no abrupt texture cutoff; no repetitively tiled same decoration; no tall stretched floor-texture walls; no floating seam strips; no giant rectangular water/pit inside; no industrial winch or old mining assets; no HUD, character portraits, buttons, arrows, labels other than four IDs. South/front foliage limited to outer corners, does not cover combat center. These are four polished map edge concepts for design approval, not screenshots.
